currentParagraphText: “Bets on if the Emberflight will make it?” Draskil asked after several moments of silence.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Bets on if the Emberflight will make it?” Draskil asked after several moments of silence.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I would assume they do, if only with a minute to spare,” Scarlett said. Sure, they said they would be late, but she still expected them to know that she wasn’t going to delay everyone just for one of the Dragonflights.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: But most importantly for those about to visit Earth, he was someone who could remove them from the surface of the planet if they annoyed him too much, and no one would do anything about it. In other words, he was someone to just leave the hell alone and, at most, admire his large metal dome from afar. At least for most... Scarlett had heard that a few of those from the Altmar Empire had plans to make contact with the Void Mechanist, and she could only wish them luck.
